verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents webhooks that send notifications of tailnet events (tailscale-docs-18) and positions webhooks and infrastructure-as-code integrations as ways to automate a tailnet (tailscale-docs-12). That gives event hooks, but the evidence shows no native rule engine for defining conditions and automatic actions; the user must build the receiving logic elsewhere. missing for 10: a native rule/trigger-action builder, documentation of configurable event-to-action rules, an event type catalog and filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-driven automation.
